main_text.p: Domini clementissimi, ea qua par est obseruãtia,rogo;illud cleméter accipere dignemini:quod vestro illustri inscriptas ac dicatas nomini,Scholas hasce meas apparere, inq; hominum venire manus volui. Scio equidem, dignas eas nõ esse, quæ lucem aspiciant: neque aspicere quoque passus fuissem, nisi amici non-nulli & studiosi quidam hoc à me ado-lescentes petiissent. Noui & illud: longè maiora atque præstantiora ea esse opor-tere, quæ tam celso illustriq; natis loco inscribenda. Verumtamen quò minus istud quod facio, facere dubitarem, fue-runt,quæ me mouerunt,plurima. Vos e-nim singulari hactenus[?] me complexi cle-mentia estis: vt meæ vicißim erga Vos obseruantiæ aliquod flagitari argumen-tum videatur. Vos vnicè literas amatis, iisdemq; & generis atq; familiæ decus ornare magis: & parare ea studetis,sine

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of the lines; the printed right margin is not visible, so the line endings may be incomplete. "hactenus" is printed with a ct ligature that is hard to read; marked [?]. Long s and ß/ss ligatures are normalised to s. The final word "quibus" stands at the right below the last line and is treated as a catchword; the paragraph is closed at the end of the visible text. The first line begins with a large initial D, joined to "Domini".
